description: Devnet v2.1 keeper (fresh-ID wrapper 5NGgnU2j315Ci2tso8VJDEthaVExuiKG3tn4xnur28xe) - TO-FILL from the Phase 3 seed output
_TO_FILL: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Do not invent slabs. Fill `markets` ONLY from the Phase 3 seed script's `newmarkets` JSON after the v2.1 deploy + re-seed (founder GO-D).

One entry per seeded market, same shape as deploy/registry.relaunch.seed.json: label, marketAddress (v2.1 slab, owner must be 5NGgnU2j...), poolAddress (mainnet DEX pool), dexType (raydium-clmm | meteora-dlmm | pumpswap), assetIndex, symbol, collateral (sim-USDC DJ54k4wH92NTtNP8RuHAwG8si1bevXEknzctDdqYN8eC), mainnetCa, and lpPortfolio if the seed output has it.
Leaving this empty is also valid: with SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_ANON_KEY set, register-poll admits v2.1 rows whose on-chain owner is 5NGgnU2j... (owner filter follows the selected wrapper).
Keep `programSet: v21`: the keeper refuses to boot (or hot-reload) a registry whose programSet differs from KEEPER_DEVNET_V21.
